VK X support for Android 5 will likely be removed in one of the next updates.

Android 5 was released in 2014 and is missing a lot for over 10 years, such as: updated network certificates, improved security, important system bugfixes and more.

Third-party libraries started dropping Android 5 support - so VK X will drop it soon.
